title: Scalar formulas for the explicit common-stage dual
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraically closed field k of characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated, quasi-compact, locally finite-type k-scheme X. Use the actual rational finite stages C_E, their scalar extensions T_h, and the literal common-stage pair category P of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let F be Finite data and let hF be FiniteCoherent as defined in [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]; thus d_E=(F.datum E).dual has the rational Verdier structures and normalized beta comparisons of [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Let V=descendedDual F hF and r_E=descendedComparison F hF E be the fixed constructions of [lem-coef-qbar-verdier-representative-functor]. Equip P with intrinsicQbarLinear, whose scalar multiplication sends a finite representative [L,f] and c∈Ω to [N,c·tr(f)] at the compositum N containing L and c. Then V.map((c·f).op)=c·V.map(f.op). Also, for c in the small coefficient model of E and any f:K→M in C_E, j_E.map((sfRationalCoefficientEquiv).symm(c)·f) equals the Ω-scalar corresponding to c under Shrink.algEquiv times j_E.map(f).

proof.text: Represent the arrow at L and the scalar in a finite field. At their compositum N, tr_mapAt and opposite_transport identify the two scalar representatives. Expand mapAt, apply finite linearity, and move the scalar past its two beta factors by bilinearity of composition.

Use intrinsicQbarLinear_existsUnique to identify scalar multiplication with the quotient formula. For a finite included arrow, evaluate that formula at E itself and use scalar compatibility of the identity transition. The composite coefficient ring equivalence and Shrink equivalence identify the two finite scalars.

lean.statement:
theorem descended_scalar_formulas (F : Finite D l hl Ω X)
    (hF : FiniteCoherent D l hl Ω X F) :
    (∀ (K M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
        (f : K ⟶ M) (c : Ω),
      (descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF).map (c • f).op =
        c • (descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF).map f.op) ∧
    (∀ (E : Index l Ω)
        (K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X)
        (f : K ⟶ M) (c : Coefficient.{u} l Ω E),
      (inclusion (Y := X) E).map
        ((sfRationalCoefficientEquiv l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)).symm c •
          (f : (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X) ⟶ M)) =
        ((Shrink.algEquiv (Padic l) E.val c : E.val) : Ω) • (inclusion E).map f)
